ROOT.scriptdef: insert into cdn.SentElem (SnE_SnTId, SnE_Pozycja, SnE_KCNId, SnE_Ilosc, SnE_JM, SnE_StawkaVat, SnE_FlagaVat) select SnT_Id, 1, SnT_KCNId, SnT_Ilosc, SnT_JM, SnT_StawkaVat, SnT_FlagaVat from cdn.Sent sz where not exists (select 1 from cdn.SentElem where SnE_SnTId = sz.SnT_Id) and SnT_KCNId > 0
